gate: Preserve the old paper-library success as a scoped historical observation; do not relabel it as failure.
A run predating the correction or testing only paper thumbnails cannot satisfy the corrected contract.
All 60 expected preset IDs must have member-level 3D derivation receipts and public card readback.
The thumbnail may be a static render, but it must derive from actual preset-specific 3D garment geometry on the declared simple mannequin.

Real WebGL, a real mannequin and 60 distinct renders are necessary technical facts but are not sufficient when garment geometry is a category/style primitive proxy rather than the selected preset's actual garment geometry.
The exact original common-person identity and original paper-native-material-solver source identity are mandatory; recipe-linked lookalikes or display shells cannot substitute.
Native failures and missing solver results must remain explicit; they cannot be converted into synthetic success.
Changing the bound person invalidates existing garment results until a new source-consistent solve is present.
Passing source lineage does not certify catalogue completion, cloth physics, fit, collision, dynamic wear, physical device behavior, public delivery, or user acceptance.
R04 source lineage and public runtime verification are preserved, but no member is user-ready unless its visible seam integrity, fold plausibility and on-body shape are independently reviewed.
Internal static engineering checks and internal screenshot approval cannot set USER-ACCEPTED or promote a garment when the user reports visible fit defects.
Member IDs for user-visible failures remain UNKNOWN until a per-preset visual ledger is produced; do not guess affected IDs from aggregate counts.

For the exact tested release, every original preset must appear exactly once in either result rows or explicit failed rows; failed rows need a phase and reason, and PNG read failure must remain distinct from solver/material failure.

A complete failure-state ledger closes only the empty/error-card observability defect; it does not repair the garment or certify physical fit, dynamic wear, outfit composition, cross-character sizing, parameter adjustability or user acceptance.
Evidence is subject-bound: current PR head or later payload-only commits cannot inherit R04.2 GATE-RUN unless their exact head is tested.

An exact push-triggered workflow run, its head SHA, workflow path, successful claim-critical steps, artifact ID/digest and retained evidence head must agree before a later Tailor candidate receives GATE-RUN.
Complete source/material/solver coverage closes missing-result execution coverage only; every static failure and every missing visual/physical/user receipt remains HOLD.
Parameter controls may pass source-geometry perturbation while altered-garment fit remains uncertified; outfit render coverage does not certify joint cloth physics.

A failed numerical trial may contribute only complete routes whose failure-category set is a strict subset of the baseline; regressions, ties and incomplete candidates must preserve the prior parent, while improved-but-failing routes remain failed.

Public verification must remain layered by exact source, public bytes, CI browser, independent browser/device and user acceptance; a WebGL getContext failure on an independent browser is a scoped runtime HOLD, not permission to substitute another model or to erase successful exact-subject publication evidence.
